discussion_comments.comment_body: My read is the Anthropic-compatible endpoint caps at 200k in practice (anthropics/claude-code#46416, MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-M2.7#46) – the 1M looks like the model spec, not what that endpoint serves. Bumping the JSON higher would just push compaction past the API reject point. Open to revisiting if MiniMax raises the Anthropic-endpoint cap, or if I'm reading the cap wrong.
I think Codex is right @sheikhlimon! Those issues you linked are reporting that MiniMax _does_ have a 1 million token context window but Claude Code isn't respecting it either.
